rows.source_ko: 국토교통부 (철도정책과), 044-201-3940
rows.text_en: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport ( Railway Policy Division ), 044-201-3940

rows.source_ko: 제1조(목적) 이 규칙은 철도산업발전기본법 및 동법시행령에서 위임된 사항과 그 시행에 관하여 필요한 사항을 규정함을 목적으로 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Framework Act on the Development of the Railway Industry and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: 제2조(철도산업전문연수기관과의 협약체결 등) ①국토교통부장관이 철도산업발전기본법(이하 “법”이라 한다) 제9조제2항의 규정에 의하여 철도산업전문연수기관과 협약을 체결하여 행정적ㆍ재정적 지원 등을 할 수 있는 교육ㆍ훈련프로그램은 다음 각호와 같다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Conclusion of Agreements, etc. with Specialized Railway Industry Training Institutions) ① The education and training programs for which the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may provide administrative and financial support, etc. by concluding an agreement with a specialized railway industry training institution pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Framework Act on the Development of the Railway Industry (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”) are as follows: <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 철도시설의 건설 및 관리에 관한 교육ㆍ훈련
rows.text_en: 1. Education and training regarding the construction and management of railway facilities

rows.source_ko: 2. 철도차량의 제작 및 관리에 관한 교육ㆍ훈련
rows.text_en: 2. Education and training regarding the manufacture and management of railway vehicles

rows.source_ko: 3. 철도차량의 운전에 관한 교육ㆍ훈련
rows.text_en: 3. Education and training regarding the operation of railway vehicles

rows.source_ko: 4. 전철전력설비ㆍ정보통신설비 등 철도관련장비의 조작 및 정비에 관한 교육ㆍ훈련
rows.text_en: 4. Education and training on the operation and maintenance of railway-related equipment, such as electric power facilities and information and communication facilities

rows.source_ko: 5. 철도관련기술에 관한 교육ㆍ훈련
rows.text_en: 5. Education and training regarding railway-related technology

rows.source_ko: 6. 철도안전관리에 관한 교육ㆍ훈련
rows.text_en: 6. Education and training on railway safety management

rows.source_ko: 7. 철도서비스에 관한 교육ㆍ훈련
rows.text_en: 7. Education and training regarding railway services

rows.source_ko: ②법 제9조제2항의 규정에 의하여 국토교통부장관과 협약을 체결할 수 있는 철도산업전문연수기관은 다음 각호와 같다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23., 2020. 9. 9.>
rows.text_en: ② The specialized railway industry training institutions that may enter into an agreement with the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport pursuant to the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Act are as follows: <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Sep. 9, 2020>

rows.source_ko: 1. 국립학교설치령에 의하여 설립된 한국철도대학
rows.text_en: 1. Korea Railway College established under the National School Establishment Decree

rows.source_ko: 2. 정부출연연구기관등의설립ㆍ운영및육성에관한법률에 의한 한국철도기술연구원
rows.text_en: 2. Korea Railroad Research Institute pursuant to the Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-funded Research Institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 3. 정부출연연구기관등의설립ㆍ운영및육성에관한법률에 의한 교통개발연구원
rows.text_en: 3. Korea Transport Institute under the Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-Funded Research Institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: 4. 법 제20조제3항에 따라 설립되는 국가철도공단(이하 “국가철도공단”이라 한다)의 부속 연수기관
rows.text_en: 4. An affiliated training institution of the Korea National Railway Corporation established pursuant to Article 20, Paragraph 3 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Korea National Railway Corporation”)

rows.source_ko: 5. 법 제21조제3항의 규정에 의하여 설립되는 한국철도공사(이하 “한국철도공사”라 한다)의 부속 연수기관
rows.text_en: 5. An affiliated training institution of the Korea Railroad Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the “Korea Railroad Corporation”) established pursuant to the provisions of Article 21, Paragraph 3 of the Act

rows.source_ko: ③ 국토교통부장관은 법 제9조제2항에 따라 철도산업전문연수기관과 협약을 체결하려는 경우에는 제1항에 따른 교육ㆍ훈련프로그램 중 지원대상이 되는 교육ㆍ훈련프로그램의 명칭, 협약 체결기관의 선정방법, 협약 체결 신청방법 등에 관한 사항을 관보 또는 「신문 등의 진흥에 관한 법률」 제9조제1항에 따라 전국을 보급지역으로 등록한 둘 이상의 일반일간신문에 공고해야 한다. <개정 2026. 9. 15.>
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport intends to enter into an agreement with a specialized railway industry training institution pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 2 of the Act, he/she shall publish matters concerning the names of the education and training programs eligible for support among the education and training programs under Paragraph 1, the method of selecting the institution to conclude the agreement, and the method of applying for the conclusion of the agreement, etc., in the Official Gazette or in two or more general daily newspapers registered for nationwide distribution pursuant to Article 9, Paragraph 1 of the Act on the Promotion of Newspapers, etc. <Amended Sep. 15, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ④제2항의 규정에 의한 철도산업전문연수기관이 제3항의 규정에 의하여 공고된 교육ㆍ훈련프로그램에 대하여 행정적ㆍ재정적 지원 등에 관한 협약체결을 신청하고자 하는 경우에는 국토교통부장관에게 다음 각호의 사항이 포함된 서류를 제출하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ④ If a specialized railway industry training institution under the provisions of Paragraph 2 intends to apply for the conclusion of an agreement regarding administrative and financial support, etc., for an education and training program announced under the provisions of Paragraph 3, it shall submit documents containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 교육ㆍ훈련의 목적 및 대상자
rows.text_en: 1. Purpose of Education and Training and Target Participants

rows.source_ko: 2. 교육ㆍ훈련의 내용ㆍ방법ㆍ기간ㆍ강사 및 장소
rows.text_en: 2. Content, method, duration, instructor, and location of education and training

rows.source_ko: 3. 교육ㆍ훈련에 소요되는 비용
rows.text_en: 3. Costs incurred for education and training

rows.source_ko: ⑤국토교통부장관은 제4항의 규정에 의한 서류를 제출받은 때에는 교육ㆍ훈련에 적합하다고 인정되는 철도산업전문연수기관을 선정하여 다음 각호의 사항이 포함된 협약을 체결하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ Upon receiving the documents pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 4, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall select a specialized railway industry training institution recognized as suitable for education and training and conclude an agreement containing the matters of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 철도산업전문연수기관의 명칭ㆍ대표자 및 위치
rows.text_en: 1. Name, Representative, and Location of the Railway Industry Specialized Training Institute

rows.source_ko: 2. 지원대상 교육ㆍ훈련프로그램
rows.text_en: 2. Education and Training Programs Eligible for Support

rows.source_ko: 3. 지원사항ㆍ지원방법 및 지원조건
rows.text_en: 3. Support Details, Support Methods, and Support Conditions

rows.source_ko: 4. 협약의 변경 및 해약에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning the amendment and termination of the agreement

rows.source_ko: 5. 협약의 위반에 관한 조치
rows.text_en: 5. Measures regarding violations of the Convention

rows.source_ko: 제2조의2(노후 철도차량의 범위) 법 제14조제4항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 노후화된 철도차량”이란 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 철도차량을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 2-2 (Scope of Aging Railway Vehicles) In Article 14, Paragraph 4 of the Act, the term “aging railway vehicles prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to railway vehicles falling under any of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 「철도안전법 시행규칙」 제75조의13제1항 각 호에 따른 정밀안전진단 기간의 다음 날부터 10년이 지난 고속철도차량
rows.text_en: 1. High-speed railway vehicles for which 10 years have passed since the day following the detailed safety diagnosis period under each subparagraph of Article 75-13, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Railway Safety Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「철도안전법 시행규칙」 제75조의13제1항 각 호에 따른 정밀안전진단 기간의 다음 날부터 5년이 지난 철도차량으로서 도시철도차량의 형식으로 제작된 철도차량. 다만, 「도시철도법 시행규칙」 제3조의2에 따른 도시철도차량은 제외한다.
rows.text_en: 2. A railway vehicle manufactured in the form of an urban railway vehicle, for which five years have passed since the day following the detailed safety diagnosis period under each subparagraph of Article 75-13, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Rule of the Railway Safety Act. However, urban railway vehicles under Article 3-2 of the Enforcement Rule of the Urban Railway Act are excluded.
[This Article Newly Inserted June 2, 2026]

rows.source_ko: 제3조(철도서비스의 품질평가방법 등) ①국토교통부장관은 법 제15조제2항의 규정에 의한 철도서비스의 품질평가(이하 “품질평가”라 한다)를 2년마다 실시한다. 다만, 필요한 경우에는 품질평가일 2주전까지 철도운영자에게 품질평가계획을 통보한 후 수시품질평가를 실시할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Method of Quality Evaluation of Railway Services, etc.) ① The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall conduct a quality evaluation of railway services (hereinafter referred to as the “Quality Evaluation”) pursuant to Article 15, Paragraph 2 of the Act every two years. However, if necessary, an ad hoc quality evaluation may be conducted after notifying the railway operator of the quality evaluation plan at least two weeks prior to the evaluation date. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ②국토교통부장관은 객관적인 품질평가를 위하여 적정 철도서비스의 수준, 평가항목 및 평가지표를 정하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall determine the appropriate level of railway service, evaluation items, and evaluation indicators for objective quality evaluation. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③국토교통부장관은 품질평가의 결과를 확정하기 전에 법 제6조의 규정에 의한 철도산업위원회(이하 “위원회”라 한다)의 심의를 거쳐야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ Before finalizing the results of the quality evaluation, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall undergo deliberation by the Railway Industry Committee pursuant to Article 6 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Committee”). <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제4조(철도시설관리대장의 작성) ①법 제30조의 규정에 의한 철도시설관리대장은 철도노선별로 작성하되, 다음 각호의 사항을 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 4 (Preparation of Railway Facility Management Register) ① The railway facility management register pursuant to Article 30 of the Act shall be prepared for each railway line, and shall include the following items:

rows.source_ko: 1. 철도노선 및 철도시설의 현황 및 도면
rows.text_en: 1. Current Status and Drawings of Railway Lines and Facilities

rows.source_ko: 2. 철도시설의 신설ㆍ증설ㆍ개량 등의 변동현황
rows.text_en: 2. Status of changes in the establishment, expansion, improvement, etc. of railway facilities

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 철도시설의 관리를 위하여 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 3. Other matters necessary for the management of railway facilities

rows.source_ko: ②제1항제1호의 규정에 의한 도면중 평면도는 철도시설 부근의 지형ㆍ방위ㆍ해발고도 등을 표시하여 축척 1,200분의 1로 작성하되, 다음 각호의 사항을 기재하여야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Among the drawings under Article 1, Paragraph 1, Item 1, the plan drawing shall be prepared at a scale of 1:1200, indicating the topography, orientation, elevation, etc., of the vicinity of the railway facility, and shall include the following items.

rows.source_ko: 1. 철도시설 및 그 경계선
rows.text_en: 1. Railway facilities and their boundaries

rows.source_ko: 2. 행정구역의 명칭 및 경계선
rows.text_en: 2. Names and Boundaries of Administrative Districts

rows.source_ko: 3. 철도시설의 위치 및 배치현황
rows.text_en: 3. Location and Layout Status of Railway Facilities

rows.source_ko: 4. 도로ㆍ공항ㆍ항만 등 철도접근교통시설
rows.text_en: 4. Railway access transportation facilities such as roads, airports, and ports

rows.source_ko: 5. 철도주변의 장애물 분포현황
rows.text_en: 5. Current Status of Obstacle Distribution Around Railways

rows.source_ko: 6. 그 밖에 철도시설의 관리를 위하여 필요한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Other matters necessary for the management of railway facilities

rows.source_ko: 제5조(선로등사용계약신청서) 철도산업발전기본법시행령(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제37조제1항의 규정에 의한 선로등사용계약신청서는 별지 제1호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Application for Contract for Use of Tracks, Lights, etc.) The application for a contract for use of tracks, lights, etc. pursuant to Article 37, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on the Development of the Railway Industry (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”) shall be in accordance with Form No. 1 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(국가부담비용정산서) 영 제42조제1항의 규정에 의한 국가부담비용정산서는 별지 제2호서식에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (State Burden Cost Settlement Statement) The State Burden Cost Settlement Statement pursuant to the provisions of Article 42, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall be in accordance with Form No. 2 of the Attached Form.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(전문기관의 지정) ①법 제33조제4항의 규정에 의한 전문기관으로 지정될 수 있는 기관은 다음 각호와 같다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Designation of Specialized Institutions) ① Institutions that may be designated as specialized institutions pursuant to the provisions of Article 33, Paragraph 4 of the Act are as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 주식회사의외부감사에관한법률 제3조의 규정에 의한 감사인의 자격이 있는 회계법인
rows.text_en: 1. An accounting firm qualified as an auditor under Article 3 of the Act on External Audits of Joint Stock Companies

rows.source_ko: 2. 정부출연연구기관등의설립ㆍ운영및육성에관한법률에 의한 정부출연연구기관중 교통관련 연구기관
rows.text_en: 2. Transportation-related research institutions among government-funded research institutions established under the Act on the Establishment, Operation, and Promotion of Government-Funded Research Institutions, etc.

rows.source_ko: ②국토교통부장관은 공익서비스비용의 산정ㆍ평가 등의 업무의 객관성을 제고하기 위하여 필요한 경우에는 제1항 각호의 규정에 의한 기관중에서 2 이상의 기관을 지정하여 공동으로 그 업무를 수행하도록 할 수 있다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② If necessary to enhance the objectivity of duties such as the calculation and evaluation of public interest service costs, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport may designate two or more institutions from among those specified in each subparagraph of Paragraph 1 to perform such duties jointly. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제8조(특정노선 폐지 등의 공고) 영 제46조의 규정에 의한 공고는 관보 또는 정기간행물의등록등에관한법률 제7조제1항의 규정에 의하여 보급지역을 전국으로 하여 등록한 2 이상의 일반일간신문에 게재하는 방법에 의한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Notice of Abolition of Specific Routes, etc.) Notices pursuant to Article 46 of the Enforcement Decree shall be made by publication in the Official Gazette or in two or more general daily newspapers registered with a distribution area nationwide pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Registration, etc. of Periodicals.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(신규철도운영자선정계획의 공고) ①국토교통부장관은 영 제48조제1항의 규정에 의하여 새로운 철도운영자(이하 “신규운영자”라 한다)를 선정하고자 하는 경우에는 위원회의 심의를 거쳐 수립한 신규운영자선정계획을 관보 또는 정기간행물의 등록등에관한법률 제7조제1항의 규정에 의하여 보급지역을 전국으로 하여 등록한 2이상의 일반일간신문에 공고하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Public Notice of Plan for Selection of New Railway Operator) ① In cases where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport intends to select a new railway operator (hereinafter referred to as the “New Operator”) pursuant to Article 48, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, the Minister shall publish the Plan for Selection of the New Operator, established after deliberation by the Committee, in the Official Gazette or in at least two general daily newspapers registered with a nationwide distribution area pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 1 of the Act on Registration, etc. of Periodicals. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ②제1항의 규정에 의한 신규운영자선정계획에는 다음 각호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The plan for selecting a new operator pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1 shall include the following matters: <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 대상 특정 노선 또는 역과 철도서비스의 내용
rows.text_en: 1. Subject: Specific routes or stations and the details of railway services

rows.source_ko: 2. 신규운영자의 선정사유
rows.text_en: 2. Reason for selecting the new operator

rows.source_ko: 3. 신규운영자의 선정방법 및 절차

rows.text_en: 4. Matters concerning compensation for losses to new operators

rows.text_en: 5. Matters concerning the contract period and contract renewal

rows.text_en: 6. Other matters deemed necessary by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport

rows.source_ko: 제10조(신규운영자의 선정) ①제9조제1항의 규정에 의하여 공고된 신규운영자선정계획에 따라 당해 특정 노선 또는 역을 운영하고자 하는 자는 사업계획을 작성하여 국토교통부장관에게 신청하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Selection of New Operators) ① Any person who intends to operate a specific route or station in accordance with the plan for the selection of new operators announced pursuant to the provisions of Article 9, Paragraph 1 shall prepare a business plan and apply to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ②국토교통부장관은 제1항의 규정에 의하여 제출받은 사업계획을 검토한 후 당해 특정 노선 또는 역을 운영하기에 적합하다고 인정되는 자를 선정하여 영 제35조제2항의 규정에 의한 선로등사용계약을 체결하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall, after reviewing the business plan submitted pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 1, select a person deemed suitable to operate the specific route or station concerned and conclude a contract for the use of tracks, etc., pursuant to the provisions of Article 35, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 제11조(신규운영자의 선정에 따른 인수인계) 영 제48조제1항의 규정에 의한 철도의 기존운영자는 동조제3항의 규정에 의하여 다음 각호의 사항이 포함된 인수인계서류를 작성하여 국토교통부장관의 확인을 받아 신규운영자에게 제공하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Handover Following Selection of New Operator) An existing railway operator pursuant to Article 48, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree shall, in accordance with Paragraph 3 of the same Article, prepare handover documents containing the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs, obtain confirmation from the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, and provide them to the new operator. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: 1. 당해 철도서비스의 내용
rows.text_en: 1. Details of the relevant railway service

rows.source_ko: 2. 당해 특정 노선의 철도역 및 투입된 철도차량
rows.text_en: 2. Railway stations on the specific line in question and railway vehicles deployed

rows.source_ko: 3. 그 밖에 철도차량의 보수ㆍ정비설비 등 당해 특정 노선의 운영에 사용된 설비 및 장비
rows.text_en: 3. Other facilities and equipment used in the operation of the specific line, such as maintenance and repair facilities for railway vehicles.

rows.source_ko: 제12조(권한의 위탁) ①국토교통부장관은 영 제50조제1항에 따라 법 제12조제2항에 따른 철도산업정보센터의 설치ㆍ운영업무를 국가철도공단에 위탁한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23., 2020. 9. 9.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Delegation of Authority) ① The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, pursuant to Article 50, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree, delegates the duties of establishing and operating the Railway Industry Information Center under Article 12, Paragraph 2 of the Act to the Korea National Railway Corporation. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013; Sep. 9, 2020>

rows.source_ko: ②국토교통부장관은 영 제50조제3항의 규정에 의하여 영 제24조제4항의 규정에 의한 철도교통관제시설의 관리업무 및 철도교통관제업무를 한국철도공사에 위탁한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ② Pursuant to the provisions of Article 50, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall entrust the management of railway traffic control facilities and railway traffic control operations under the provisions of Article 24, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree to the Korea Railroad Corporation. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>

rows.source_ko: ③국토교통부장관은 제2항의 규정에 의하여 한국철도공사에 철도교통관제업무를 위탁하는 경우에는 한국철도공사로부터 철도교통관제업무에 종사하는 자의 독립성이 보장될 수 있도록 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다. <개정 2008. 3. 14., 2013. 3. 23.>
rows.text_en: ③ In cases where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport entrusts railway traffic control duties to the Korea Railroad Corporation pursuant to the provisions of Paragraph 2, the Minister shall take necessary measures to ensure the independence of persons engaged in railway traffic control duties from the Korea Railroad Corporation. <Amended Mar. 14, 2008; Mar. 23, 2013>
Article 13 Deleted <September 15, 2026>

rows.source_ko: ②(철도교통관제업무 등의 위탁에 관한 특례) 제12조제2항의 규정에 불구하고 한국철도공사가 설립되기 전까지는 철도청장을 동조동항의 규정에 의한 한국철도공사로 본다.
rows.text_en: ② (Special provisions regarding the entrustment of railway traffic control duties, etc.) Notwithstanding the provisions of Article 12, Paragraph 2, until the Korea Railroad Corporation is established, the Administrator of the Korea Railroad Administration shall be deemed the Korea Railroad Corporation pursuant to the provisions of the same Article and Paragraph.
